name: cache-live
description: A live prompt-cache timer for Claude Code: ticks the HOT countdown every second and publishes the exact cache window for status lines.

plugins.name: cache-live
plugins.description: Live prompt-cache timer: hooks the finished turns, ticks the remaining TTL each second via $.ui.status, and writes the exact window (anchor, expiresAt, token usage) to ~/.cache/ccstatusline/cache-live-<session>.json for status line scripts.
